meta.visualSummary: The UI is a mobile movie app with a black, cinematic shell, large poster-driven hero imagery, red as the primary action color, subtle white typography, rounded cards, translucent circular icon buttons, and a persistent bottom navigation. The composition emphasizes movie artwork first, then metadata, ratings, synopsis, and one dominant call-to-action.

appShell.shape: Full-height mobile viewport with large rounded outer corners
appShell.feel: Edge-to-edge content inside a soft-radius device-safe frame
appShell.surfaceStyle: Dark glass / matte black surface with faint gradients and subtle overlay layers

safeAreas.top: Reserved for status bar and overlay controls
safeAreas.bottom: Reserved for persistent tab bar and gesture/home indicator

navigationPattern.contentFlow: Poster hero -> title/meta -> ratings -> CTA -> synopsis/details

base.hero: large poster image occupying the upper half of the screen
base.actions: overlay circular icon buttons in top corners

sm.layout: single column remains, but content can breathe more horizontally
sm.hero: wider content margins, slightly larger typography scale
sm.cards: poster carousels can increase visible card count from ~2 to ~3

md.layout: movie detail may become a split layout
md.hero: poster/media can sit above or left of metadata depending on orientation
md.navigation: bottom nav may remain for app parity, but can expand spacing
md.content: ratings and metadata can align in rows with more separation

lg.layout: 2-column detail layout recommended: media left, content right
lg.onboarding: full-bleed art with centered marketing copy

xl.layout: content constrained within centered max-width frame
xl.nav: bottom nav can transform into side rail or top nav if needed, but visual language should remain identical
xl.density: same spacious feel; avoid turning it into a dense dashboard

2xl.layout: cinematic layouts with generous negative space
2xl.hero: poster, trailer, cast, synopsis, and recommendations can coexist on one screen
2xl.surface: retain dark immersive mood; avoid excessive whitespace without atmospheric backgrounds

colorSystem.strategy: Use only two primary semantic palettes plus neutrals and accents for media-heavy surfaces. Red is the dominant brand/action color. The secondary palette is a violet-magenta tone used for branding, minor highlights, and decorative gradients.

darkMode.mediaTreatment: Poster artwork remains vivid against near-black surroundings with heavy bottom fade for readability

lightMode.themeRole: adapted variant, not shown directly but inferred

interactive.secondaryAction: gray-100 or white with subtle border

lightMode.mediaTreatment: Hero still uses image overlays, but fade should resolve into a light surface so typography remains readable without muddying the artwork

typography.tone: Bold, modern, clean sans-serif with compact headings and clear metadata hierarchy

fontBehavior.titles: semibold to bold, tight leading, slight tracking normalization
fontBehavior.body: comfortable line height for synopsis copy
fontBehavior.microLabels: tiny uppercase or compact label chips

observedHierarchy: movie title is the primary textual anchor
genre, duration, year sit directly under the title
ratings row is higher priority than synopsis
CTA is given more visual priority than descriptive copy

statusBar.appearance: standard OS status content over image or dark surface
statusBar.contrast: white in dark mode, dark text in light mode

placement.left: back or menu control near upper-left over hero image

style.background: translucent dark or light blur surface
style.icon: white or gray-900 depending on theme

states.hoverOrPressed: slightly brighter fill and stronger shadow
states.active: can pick up primary tint if semantic

branding.observed: Small brandmark plus wordmark on home/onboarding screens
branding.style: gradient or multicolor icon with white wordmark in dark mode
branding.placement: top-left to top-center area depending on page

heroPosterSection.role: dominant visual identity for the selected movie

layout.image: portrait poster / key art filling upper half of the screen
layout.crop: full bleed within safe margins, rounded corners on home poster card, more integrated full-width on detail page
layout.overlay: strong bottom gradient for text readability

behavior.detailPage: poster art occupies ~45–55% of visible screen height
behavior.homePage: large central poster card within carousel
behavior.onboarding: multiple posters form a collage with text overlay lower down

watchTrailerChip.placement: lower-left area over the hero image near the image fade boundary

style.icon: small play glyph in primary red or white

movieTitleBlock.layout: left aligned stack immediately below hero image

titleStyle.case: uppercase in screenshot, but token should support title case

favoriteAction.placement: right side aligned with title/meta block

style.icon: heart filled with primary red when active

style.background: elevated dark surface in dark mode; white or gray-100 in light mode

content.imdb: yellow branded accent with numeric score

primaryCTA.label: Watch now
primaryCTA.priority: highest interactive priority on the screen

style.heading: small bold section label
style.body: 2–5 lines preview in mobile, expandable if needed

behavior.mobile: truncate with fade or 'Read more' after a few lines

inferredFromLeftDevice.featuredPoster: large centered poster with coverflow-like framing
inferredFromLeftDevice.indicator: small carousel progress dots/pills below featured poster
inferredFromLeftDevice.contentRow: horizontal movie cards with poster art
inferredFromLeftDevice.fab: prominent circular red action button near lower-left, overlapping content
inferredFromLeftDevice.tabBar: bottom nav with search and other icons

inferredFromRightDevice.background: poster collage grid with dark gradient overlay
inferredFromRightDevice.primaryCTA: large red pill button near bottom
inferredFromRightDevice.secondaryTextLink: small sign-in / account action below button

style.background: dark elevated layer with subtle transparency

visualBehavior.active: either filled primary circular highlight or stronger icon contrast

bottomTabBar.specialCase: One action appears as a larger floating red circular button on some screens; treat this as a prominent primary tab or quick action

posterCard.focus: center poster has the strongest scale and visibility

carouselBehavior.featured: single highlighted poster with adjacent previews peeking

global: Poster artwork is clickable and often the main entry into detail pages
Circular overlay buttons use low-opacity fills and become more opaque on interaction
Primary CTA remains visually dominant at all times
Bottom nav persists across core screens

microInteractions.favoriteToggle: heart fill animation with subtle burst/glow
microInteractions.carouselScroll: adjacent posters parallax or scale subtly
microInteractions.tabChange: active icon tint shift + optional motion on indicator
microInteractions.heroTransition: poster image expands/crossfades into detail hero

contrast.darkMode: Use strong white-on-dark contrast for primary text; metadata may soften but should remain readable over media
contrast.lightMode: Keep body text at gray-700/900; avoid light gray over poster fades

touchTargets.minimum: 44x44px for all interactive icons and pills

movieDetail.visualBalance: Top half is image-led; bottom half is text/action-led

doNotDo: Do not introduce more than two main color palettes for core UI semantics
Do not flatten the cinematic depth into a generic flat dashboard
Do not overuse outlined components; surfaces should feel soft, layered, and poster-led
Do not let text float directly on busy poster art without gradient support
Do not make light mode sterile; it should preserve the premium media-app mood
